title: INTERSECT with the tables swapped keeps the duplicates of the other table

source.quote: Intersect is not commutative. In general, Intersect(T1, T2) will have a different result set than Intersect(T2, T1).
source.supports: the page shows these two tables and this result for Intersect(States2, States1)

derivation: Left is now B, C, D, D, D, E. B, C and D are in the other table; E is not. So B, C, D, D, D.
